readBy: hand, from the page itself (not from any scanner); docs/FIXTURES.md says what each property means

fields.label: Resume/CV
fields.note: A file input hidden by opacity 0 inside the visible ATTACH RESUME/CV link (a.visible-resume-upload). A wrapping label never qualifies a file input, so the Lever adapter's uploadWidgets() must declare that link. Required only by the label's marker (span.required): the input has no required attribute.

fields.label: Pronouns
fields.note: Nine pronouns and Use name only share name=pronouns. The group's label is a div.application-label that no label element, legend or aria attribute ties to the boxes, so the Lever adapter's labelFor() must supply it. Each box has its own wrapping label.

fields.label: Custom
fields.note: No name, so it is not part of the pronouns group: the page's script uses it only to show the custom pronouns box below it.

fields.label: Write here...
fields.note: display: none until Custom is ticked (a reveal, Phase 3). Its only text is its placeholder.

fields.label: Current location
fields.note: Lever's structured location question: a text input whose suggestions come from Lever's location search into div.dropdown-results, with no ARIA roles in the markup. Typing alone may not satisfy it.

fields.label: Have you ever been previously employed by Spotify?
fields.note: No, Yes - Intern, Yes - Full Time Employment, as checkboxes. Lever's custom questions are labelled by a div.application-label .text above the control, which no label element ties to it, so the Lever adapter's labelFor() must supply it.

fields.label: What is your location?
fields.note: No name. Choosing a country shows that country's survey below (the page's script, a reveal for Phase 3); the first option is Select....

fields.label: What best describes your gender?
fields.note: In the survey for the United States (div#countrySurvey_US, class hidden: display: none until What is your location? names that country).

fields.label: What is your race/ethnicity?:
fields.note: In the hidden survey for the United States.

fields.label: Are you a veteran/have you served in the military?
fields.note: In the hidden survey for the United States.

fields.label: What best describes your gender?
fields.note: In the hidden survey for a long list of countries (div#countrySurvey_AL_DZ_AS_...).

fields.label: What gender do you identify with?
fields.note: In the hidden survey for another list of countries (div#countrySurvey_AF_AZ_BH_...).

fields.label: What best describes your gender?
fields.note: In the hidden survey for the United Kingdom (div#countrySurvey_GB).

fields.label: What best describes your ethnicity?
fields.note: In the hidden survey for the United Kingdom.

fields.label: Spotify has my consent to contact me about future job opportunities.
fields.note: Marketing consent: never ticked unless the person pre-approved it. It sits in an untitled part of the form (div[data-qa=consent-section]) after the surveys, so the nearest visible heading above it is Demographic Survey's. The label's text comes before the box inside its wrapping label.
